# Roadmap

## P0 - Foundation

- Project structure.
- Public interfaces.
- Documentation.
- Tests and CI skeleton.
- Build/typecheck/lint/test passing.

## P1 - Transport

- Fetch transport.
- AbortController timeouts.
- HTTP status classification.
- JSON parsing and response validation.

## P2 - Client orchestration

- Request construction.
- Id assignment.
- Retry loop.
- Failover.
- NodePool integration.

## P3 - Observability and extension

- Hooks execution.
- Metrics emission.
- Logger redaction.

## P4 - Batch and cache

- `callBatch` correlation.
- Explicit cache provider integration.

## P5 - Consumer integration

- Integrate through adapters in sibling projects without changing their public APIs.
